reason: CapabilityEditor composes one capability modal lifetime: current tab, explicit initial Profile/create-Name focus and connected-opener restoration, the retained Profile form and source-scoped Documents panel, plus the existing remove confirmation. Its single useCapabilityMutation remains the only capability operation owner; actor/client/lifetime validation, transport, receipts and invalidation stay in the unchanged execution/writer/mutation modules. Moving the independent Profile draft and native form projection into CapabilityForm removes that prior responsibility from the editor. Retain this exact modal composition. Files owns all document queries, upload and readiness through its public EntityDocuments export.

CapabilityForm owns one mounted local capability Profile draft and the exact existing native submission projection for create/update. Keeping token/TRL state, uncontrolled named metadata fields, conditional create/saved sections and the explicit submit footer together makes hidden Details values and tab-retained draft values part of one form. Identity, disclosure and readiness field presentation is delegated to CapabilityFields; token behavior remains in canonical TokenInput. This 128-line body does not perform transport, query/cache effects or authorization: onSave sends the same eleven-field CapabilityInput to the editor's one guarded mutation. Retain this cohesive form; extract a section only if it gains an independent lifecycle or public caller, rather than splitting the coupled draft projection and field arrangement by line count.
